messages:
maria: quick heads-up — noticed throughput drop on paged-flash variant when KV layout interleaved + bf16 and batch size >8. Repro on nightly with model_xsmall. Profiling attached. :warning:
perf-bot: nightly-bench reported 18% p99 latency increase for model_xsmall: paged-flash-interleaved-bf16, build 2026-03-15-rc4. Link: https://benchboard/reports/174567
kai: ugh. Is this kernel selection switching to fused fallback? Any kernel logs?
maria: yes, kernel selector chose flash_paged_fallback path after warp-miss spikes. Here's stripped log:
```
[selector] seqlen=1024 batch=12 dtype=bf16 -> choose=flash_paged_fallback (cost=1.23)
[kernel] bank_conflicts=23 warp_miss=0.18
```
lena: batch heuristics note: our continuous-batcher will increase reqs to 12 for that QPS; maybe stride alignment got worse at batch>8. Can we repro smaller?
jon: quick repro script I used:
```
PYTHONPATH=. python -m perf.run --model xsmall --seq 1024 --batch 12 --dtype bf16 --kv interleaved
```
maria: i ran with separate-kv and no regression. interleaved seems culprit. With separate, throughput stable and kernel=flash_fused.
kai: could be alignment padding mismatch. interleaved stores [B, heads, bank, shard] ordering; for bf16 stride becomes odd. Anyone have trace of pointer offsets?
maria: trace snippet:
```
kv_ptr=0x7f3a... offset=128 stride=40 bytes
kv_bank_stride % 64 = 40 -> unaligned
```
lena: suggests we add pad_to=64 in alloc for interleaved when dtype=bf16 or when seqlen%128!=0. Patch incoming?
maria: i can run quick validate. If add pad_to=64 throughput goes back to baseline. Will open PR with microbench results. :eyes:
kai: also add a guard in kernel selector to prefer fused when bank_conflicts > threshold and dtype=bf16. That avoids fallback thrash.
jon: for rollout, can we set selector fallback to prefer separate-kv for dedicated tier until fix lands? Ops/rollout config?
maria: yes, config change trivial. Will coordinate with product for canary. Plan: patch alloc -> validate microbench -> selector rule -> canary 10% -> full.
perf-bot: perf diff summary: baseline->patched padding: throughput +15%, p95 down 12%, kernel selection stable.
kai: awesome. assign owners: maria (fix + PR), lena (alloc patch), jon (canary), kai (selector rule).
maria: assigning now. will post PR link once ready.
lena: copying note: remember to add unit test for allocator alignment on cudaMalloc.
jon: thumbs up. :thumbsup:
perf-bot: deploy scheduled: canary 10% at 1745682500 if PR merged.
